PRESS Modern Massage is a therapist-founded, independently owned massage therapy company in New York City. Since 2008, our licensed massage therapists have provided personalized therapeutic massage for people managing muscle tension, stress, neck and back discomfort, desk posture, athletic recovery, pregnancy, and everyday body care.

On this channel, PRESS therapists share practical massage education, mobility and recovery guidance, self-care techniques, and answers to common questions about deep tissue, Swedish, sports, prenatal, and therapeutic massage. Visit PRESS locations in Williamsburg, Greenpoint, Union Square, Columbus Circle, and Long Island City. Book a massage or learn more at pressmodernmassage.com!
